senses.gloss: f. (denom. of שֵׁן; v. מְשׁוּנִּיתָא) cliff, rocky bluffs. Ohol. XVIII, 6 ואיזה הש׳ וכ׳ how far is it called shunnith (for ritual purposes)? As far as the sea comes up when it is rough.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 7:2:10">Y. Shek. VII, 50ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שׁוּנַּת הים</he>, <he>שונת הנהר</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:2">Tosef. B. Mets. II, 2</cite> Var. <he>שֻׁנִּית</he>, v. <cite ref="U01580"><he>שְׁנוּנִית</he></cite>.
